title: CosmicX
description: Build your Imagination! CosmicX requires NO MODS to play!
body: CosmicX is a great server to let your creative juices flow! From Plots, to Freebuild, to a MASSIVE City Hub with buyable/sellable properties that you can buy with coins, (earned from voting and your playtime!) we have a lot! If you want a server with a tight-knit community and awesome features, come join us! It supports Worldedit on plots, and axiom! We have an amazing and kind community for you to explore!
